resources.string: Give the 4-digit code to the rep who is setting up a new phone. It works once and expires. Needs internet.
No reps in your area are waiting for a code.
No connection. Codes are never kept on the phone: connect to the internet and pull to refresh.
This account cannot use Device OTP.
The server answer could not be read. Pull to refresh.
No connection. The code was not issued. Try again online.
The server did not issue a code (this rep may be outside your area, or too many codes were asked for). Try again later.
Your sign-in has ended. Log out and log in again, then open Device OTP.
